data.name: 愿你拿一手同花顺 May the cards lay out a straight
data.detailed_description:
Jack, a winning gambler, is trapped at the gambling table by his angry boss's magic spell. He is horrified to find the dice rushing towards him. Only by gripping his playing cards tightly and shattering all the incoming dice can he hope to escape the table alive.Meanwhile, don't forget your golden dice friends; trade the dice souls you've collected with them to gain incredible power.

Hand Cards

Jack can use five hand cards simultaneously, and the base damage of each card is related to its face value. During the card selection phase, try to choose cards with higher point values.

Suit Bonus

Having three or more cards of the same suit in your hand will grant you a bonus effect. The more cards of the same suit you have, the stronger the bonus effect.

Different suits have different bonus effects:

  • Spades: Increased firing speed

  • Hearts: Increased critical hit chance

  • Clubs: Increased firing rate

  • Diamonds: Increased shooting range

Hand Rank Bonus

Specific card combinations provide damage bonuses, with different combinations offering varying levels of enhancement, from lowest to highest:

  • Pair: Two cards of the same rank, with the remaining cards being any single cards. For example, 22 + 456.

  • Two Pair: Two cards of the same rank plus two other cards of another matching rank, plus one other arbitrary card. For example, 44 + 55 + 1.

  • Three of a Kind: Three cards of the same rank plus two arbitrary cards. For example, 555 + 12.

  • Straight: Five cards in sequential rank. For example, 34567.

  • Flush: Five cards of the same suit. For example, Diamond 2, Diamond 3, Diamond 4, Diamond 5, Diamond 8.

  • Full House: Three cards of the same rank plus two cards of another matching rank. For example, JJJ + KK.

  • Four of a Kind: Four cards of the same rank and one arbitrary card. For example, Spade 4, Heart 4, Club 4,         Diamond 4 and Club 3.

  • Straight Flush: Five cards of the same suit in sequential rank. For example, Club K, Club Q, Club J, Club 10, Club 9.

  •  Royal Flush: The highest straight flush of the same suit. For example, Spade A, Spade K, Spade Q, Spade J, Spade 10.

Gold Dice

Not all dice are enemies of Jack. The gold dice are the exiled kings among dice. Leveraging their abilities can aid you in achieving victory.

Vice Card

In the battle of vice cards, upgrading the gold dice will generate various sub-cards, including those with passive effects and skill sub-cards with extraordinary abilities. After purchasing sub-cards with dice souls, don't forget to allocate them to your hand.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K, 3.9 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X, 3.7 GHz
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
